content.text:
According to the project memory, the notifier has belonged to the Growth team since 2026-09-01, when Dana Okafor moved to Platform. Copy and template changes are signed off in **#growth-eng**, and any Growth engineer can approve. You don't need a specific named owner.

I haven't checked this against the repo, so it's only as current as the memory.

Two things to keep in mind when you edit the wording:
- Templates are in `services/notifier/templates/` as `<event>.mjml`. Each one needs a plain-text twin, `<event>.txt`, with the same variables, because some corporate mail gateways strip HTML. If you change the wording in one file, change it in the other too.
- Template variables are snake_case.

I can find the receipt template and make the edit if you want.
